obligations.target: hfsplus-format / header, fork and region arithmetic
obligations.property: Accepted geometry, block size/count and fork ranges fit exact bounded raw image; no integer overflow or out-of-range indexing.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: Kani full u64 values, arrays up to 8 extents, arbitrary truncated byte buffers; native min/max admissible profiles.
obligations.negative_witness: allocation block index multiplied by size overflows

obligations.property: Validated node offset table partitions records without overlap with descriptors/table; every parsed key and data range valid, typed and monotone under correct comparator.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: Kani <=8 records/128-byte synthetic packing and real nodes tested at qualified sizes; endian exact; comparator contract.
obligations.negative_witness: offset table points into itself; malformed node count reads before start

obligations.target: hfsplus-pomologie-core name keys, hfsplus-builder planner, and hfsplus-reader catalog lookup
obligations.property: Name canonicalization is idempotent on admitted names; sibling equality agrees with historical HFS+ profile; comparator antisymmetry/transitivity, sorting and lookup agree; collisions rejected.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: Exhaustive ordered triples for 94 kernel and 92 scalar canonical names, 4,096 seeded triples, planner ordering and 1,024 lookups across 16 exact separators. Live CoreServices checks 65,536 UTF-16 units, 40,000 seeded pairs and 76 directed pairs. One mounted 64 MiB HFS+ image supplies the native name corpus.
obligations.negative_witness: generic modern Unicode folding accepts an HFS+ collision

obligations.target: hfsplus-format, hfsplus-reader / forks and link resolver
obligations.property: Logical fork read returns exact data within allocated coverage; forks distinct; hard-link identity and reference count consistent for admitted regular-file profile; traversal cannot cycle indefinitely.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: Native source metadata known, lengths representable; small reference tree <=12 nodes, extents <=8; unsupported directory links explicitly refused until qualified.
obligations.negative_witness: resource fork confused with data fork; hardlink deref cycle

obligations.property: Each live catalog object gets one valid CNID in correct namespace; parent/thread references resolve; generated asset length changes do not change frozen IDs; no reserved collisions.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: Finite tree <=16 entries + overflow boundaries; deterministic comparator; identities fixed before seal.
obligations.negative_witness: reallocation after alias bytes generated changes CNID

obligations.property: All allocated block ranges contained, disjoint for distinct owners except qualified links; bitmap and allocated/free counts equal reference sets; required reserved and metadata regions protected.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: Kani up to 32 blocks for 512- and 4096-byte block sizes and one full-width transition from any admitted cursor; four positive property layouts, one independent block ownership comparison, and one native free-count fixture.

obligations.target: hfsplus-builder / interval plan and range producer
obligations.property: Sealed ranges cover [0,image_len) exactly once, known zeros explicit, source data exact; arbitrary partial reads concatenate to identical sequential output, source mutation fails.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: Kani <=8 ranges with arbitrary u64 endpoints; immutable bounded source contract; native raw image output.
obligations.negative_witness: gap implicitly zeroed over unplanned metadata; short source read accepted

obligations.target: hfsplus-reader / pure B-tree descent and key search
obligations.property: For a validated finite tree, search returns unique matching record iff present in abstract sorted map; separator routing and leaf iteration preserve total ordering; invalid links error, cycle bounded.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: Property/reference random histories; proof pilot later for pure packed search, not arbitrary malicious tree without validation.
obligations.negative_witness: wrong boundary separator routes equal key to adjacent leaf

obligations.property: Unsupported journal/feature/compression type never masquerades as complete read; supported compressed fork exact declared size and within budget; malformed object yields error.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: Only individually qualified compression types, external codec contract; native type fixtures; bounded read counters.
obligations.negative_witness: unknown decmpfs type returns empty file

obligations.target: hfsplus-format + hfsplus-builder / pure interval and packing helpers
obligations.property: Actual extracted Rust checked interval construction, allocation merge and packing refine mathematical nonoverlapping cover model, preserving capacity and exact record boundaries for all representable accepted inputs.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: Lean natural arithmetic + machine-width conversion; extraction of pure safe helpers only; comparator/table and I/O assumptions separately tested.
obligations.negative_witness: overlapping allocation accepted after arithmetic truncation

obligations.property: Create/unlink/rename/replace/setattr preserve unrelated object bytes and catalog/tree/link/allocation invariants; no new writable profile claimed crash-consistent yet.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: Exclusive disposable image, <=6 objects/16 blocks, mutation history and failures; no guarantee data atomicity on arbitrary in-place overwrites.
obligations.negative_witness: rename into descendant creates cycle; unlink frees still-linked file

obligations.property: Metadata recovery selects admissible old/new transaction state; replay applies only committed verified records once logically; crash during replay idempotent; no referenced block wrongly free.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: TLC <=2 transactions/3 metadata blocks, bounded torn writes/flush/crashes; actual device order/alignment and HFS journal profile separately qualified; user data semantics separate.
obligations.negative_witness: commit record durable before required journal data; replay writes arbitrary home offset

obligations.property: No live or reserved block becomes out-of-range after qualified resize; block device alignment, exclusive ownership and durable barriers enforced; failed resize/reopen reports exact state.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: Model <=32 blocks and two barriers; only qualified resize modes; native disposable image and no_std separate evidence.
obligations.negative_witness: shrink below live extent; header changed before referenced allocation relocated

obligations.property: Production-linked proof of binary-search correctness and packing/free-space arithmetic against reference specs, with checked preconditions and exact type conversions.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: Safe sequential subset; no proof of entirety of tree mutations, journaling or hardware.
obligations.negative_witness: binary search returns insertion point as equality
